result.title: One name. Two worlds. A shared commitment to safety. 🏔️🚗
result.description:
When principal software systems engineer Rez Nemati set out to scale Alpamayo, the famed pyramidal peak in the Peruvian Andes, he realized the mountain shares more than just a name with NVIDIA’s open ecosystem of reasoning vision-language-action AI models, simulation tools, and datasets for autonomous vehicles and robotaxis. 

Both demand preparation, careful decisions, and layers of protection when the stakes are high. 

Follow his climb to explore the connection between mountain and machine.
